patterns.note: Generous vertical spacing between major content sections creates an airy and uncluttered page flow.
Alternating background colors (white and black) are used to clearly delineate main content blocks, particularly for the footer.
A strong contrast in typography is used, pairing clean, bold sans-serif headings and body text with an extremely oversized, elegant serif display font for the brand name in the footer.
A predominantly monochrome palette (black, white, various greys) is accented with specific, vibrant colors (blue and orange) for call-to-action buttons and key highlights.
A persistent header with the site logo and navigation links remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: Content sections are presented with ample vertical padding, creating a spacious and breathable layout that emphasizes individual content blocks.

A fixed header element is positioned at the top of the viewport, maintaining visibility of the site identity and primary navigation as the user scrolls down the page. Other content sections simply scroll into and out of view without additional scroll-triggered animations.
Call-to-action buttons utilize solid background colors with contrasting text, providing clear visual targets and a sense of urgency or importance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with legible body text, complemented by a distinctive, extremely oversized serif display font in the footer (~8-10x body).
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and input fields, otherwise sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero section and between major content blocks, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and elegant typographic contrast, particularly the dramatic, oversized serif logo in the footer. This unexpected element elevates a clean, minimal layout into a memorable brand statement, combining modern clarity with classic sophistication.
